productName: Tab Stasher — Named Window Parking, Per-Tab Notes & Markdown Export

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of stashing research tab windows with context notes for later getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With Tab Stasher, Per-Window & Per-Tab Context Annotations runs right where you already work. Explicit User-Commanded Window Stashing and One-Click Clean Markdown Research Export—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle stashing research tab windows with context notes for later, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch Tab Stasher in action: Name the whole stashed window ("Q4 Tax Prep" or "Auth Bug Investigation") and jot a specific note under any individual tab so context never evaporates. Not an aggressive background tab killer that breaks active forms. Park a window intentionally when you switch projects and restore it when you return. Plus, turn any stashed window—complete with tab titles, URLs, and your personal annotations—into a formatted Markdown checklist for Obsidian or GitHub PRs. Use tristate checkboxes to reopen or export all tabs or just a selected subset—with zero cloud accounts and zero telemetry. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
